title: Restart the airp app
detail: A new version is installed (long-term picks page, run history, the fact sheet the judge read). It shows after a restart.

title: Google Cloud project ID for the news archive
detail: The news download for the research test takes about 350 more hours the slow way. With a free BigQuery project it takes minutes. Free tier only; every query is checked for cost first.

title: Judge 'on time' by the moment a decision is written
detail: Today the runner compares the market open with the time the run started. A slow run could record a late decision as on time. It has not happened (all six were written at least 42 minutes early). The fix is three lines in the frozen runner, so it needs your yes. The outside review of 1 Oct found the same thing and adds: store the start, finish and write times separately. Recommended: yes.

title: How to score a long-term pick that stops trading
detail: If a pick is bought out or delisted before its 3 months are up, its cohort cannot be scored today. Usual practice: count it at its last traded price. Needed before the first cohort closes (about 30 Dec).

title: Entry day in winter (from 1 Nov)
detail: After the clocks change, a report filed between 08:00 and 09:30 New York time is traded at that day's open but scored from the next day's. The score stays honest but measures a slightly different trade. Both rules were fixed in advance; changing either is your call. The outside review of 1 Oct recommends one rule for both, taken from the exchange calendar (which also settles holidays), recorded once per decision. Needed before 1 Nov.

title: The reader sometimes compares with the previous quarter instead of last year
detail: Seen on Micron: sales 'up 31% from a year earlier' when it was up 379% (31% was against the quarter before). About 3% of past reports. The SEC figures could replace the reader's, but that changes what the judge sees: a new version to test, which needs the graphics card. The outside review of 1 Oct suggests going further: attach the period, units and accounting basis to every figure the reader extracts. Either way it is a new reader version, tested on past reports before it replaces the live one.

title: Reports published while the PC is off for more than 3 days
detail: They are not written into the ledger as missed (the daily check does alert on the missing runs). Small, but the count of missed decisions would be too low after a long outage.

title: What the broker account should do if the 2.5x book is ever wiped out
detail: The paper book would close, but its positions at the broker would stay open because the mirror only follows new targets. Practice money only; needs a rule.

title: Test a clean install (downloads Python packages)
detail: The package list was incomplete and is now fixed and pinned. Proving it on a fresh environment means downloading the packages again (roughly 1 to 2 GB, free). Downloads need your OK.

title: Rebuild how the runner reports its steps
detail: Today alerts are found by reading each step's printed text. The outside review recommends each step returning a small status record instead. It touches every scheduled job, so I would do it on a weekend with rehearsals, not during earnings season without your yes.
